content:
The surge current rating is related to the \( I^2 t \) rating.  
For half-cycle (10 ms at 50 Hz), \( I^2 \times t \) is constant.  

Given:  
Half-cycle surge current \( I_{h} = 3000 \text{ A} \)  
Time for half-cycle \( t_h = 0.01 \text{ s} \)  

So \( I^2 t = (3000)^2 \times 0.01 = 90000 \times 0.01 = 900 \)  

For one full cycle (20 ms), \( I_f^2 \times 0.02 = 900 \)  
\( I_f^2 = 900 / 0.02 = 45000 \)  
\( I_f = \sqrt{45000} \approx 2121.32 \text{ A} \)  

Final answer: (C)
